## Change tracking

Choose one of the following paths and remove the other two before submitting
the pull request:

- **Substantial change:** link the originating development issue in the pull
  request description with `Closes #<number>`.
- **Mechanical change:** typo-only, comment-only, formatting-only, or similarly
  mechanical changes do not need an issue when they do not affect behavior or
  a public compatibility surface.
- **Maintainer-approved exception:** when a substantial change has no issue,
  explain why and link the maintainer's written approval here:
  <!-- approval link and maintainer name -->

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the tests and checks relevant to this change.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I reviewed the documentation and user-facing wording for consistency.
